title: Filled Without Measure
story:
A young boy was learning to paint from his grandfather.

His grandfather never gave him only a tiny amount of paint and told him to be afraid of using it.

Instead, he patiently showed him how to mix the colors, fill the brush, and let the paint flow onto the canvas.

As the boy practiced, his confidence grew.

One day, he looked at the finished painting and realized how much could happen when he stopped holding back.

God does not give His Spirit to us in a limited or measured way.

He is not reluctant to work in our lives.

When God speaks, His words carry His authority and truth because He gives the Spirit without measure.

We can therefore listen to Him with confidence and allow His Spirit to work deeply within us.

Instead of trying to live the Christian life only through our own strength, we can depend on the Spirit God has given us.

His presence equips us, guides us, and helps us live according to God's truth.
life_lesson: God gives His Spirit generously. We can depend on His presence and power rather than trying to live only through our own strength.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for giving Your Spirit without measure.

Help me to depend on Your Spirit instead of relying only on my own strength and understanding.

Fill my heart with Your truth and guide my thoughts, words, and actions.

Help me to listen when You speak and faithfully follow where You lead.

May Your Spirit work freely in my life and help me become more like Christ.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you trying to handle everything through your own strength?

Where do you need to depend more on God's Spirit today?

How can you become more attentive to God's voice and guidance?
verse: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
